name: MEMCARD_DRAW_PARAMS
source: usage: {short x; short y; short tpage; u16 clut; u16 *frame; +0xc; u16 *str; Glyph *font} the memCardDraw* functions fill for memCardDrawString / the part draws (same layout as SUBSCREEN_DRAW_PARAMS) refs=55

name: MEMCARD_DRAW_Y
source: usage: MEMCARD_DRAW_PARAMS.y refs=6

name: MEMCARD_DRAW_TPAGE
source: usage: MEMCARD_DRAW_PARAMS.tpage (4 before the file texts / 1 before the icon label) refs=11

name: MEMCARD_DRAW_CLUT
source: usage: MEMCARD_DRAW_PARAMS.clut refs=4

name: MEMCARD_DRAW_STR
source: usage: MEMCARD_DRAW_PARAMS.str: the u16 string memCardDrawString renders refs=4

name: MEMCARD_DRAW_FONT
source: usage: MEMCARD_DRAW_PARAMS.font: the 5-byte glyph table pointer refs=4

name: MEMCARD_FONT
source: usage: the 5-byte {u v w h flag} glyph table of the memory card screen stored into MEMCARD_DRAW_PARAMS.font refs=7

name: MEMCARD_YESNO_CURSOR
source: usage: int: 0 yes / 1 no of the prompt messages 7 / 12 / 16 (memCardFileListStep / FormatStep / DrawMessage) refs=29

name: MEMCARD_CURSOR_Y_TARGET
source: usage: short: cursor row * 0x28 the highlight scrolls to refs=14

name: MEMCARD_CURSOR_Y
source: usage: short: the highlight's current y (moves 8 px per frame towards MEMCARD_CURSOR_Y_TARGET) refs=13

name: MEMCARD_LIST_SCROLL
source: usage: short: scroll offset of the file list (follows the cursor; the up / down arrows show while it can move) refs=19

name: MEMCARD_FILE_ORDER
source: usage: short[2][16]: per card the directory entries in display order (sorted by save slot) refs=22

name: MEMCARD_FILE_COUNT
source: usage: short[2]: per card the number of listed entries refs=15

name: MEMCARD_SLOT_PRESENT
source: usage: int[2]: a card answered the probe in slot 1 / 2 refs=8

name: MEMCARD_SELECTED_SLOT
source: usage: int: the card slot in use (1 / 2; 0 none) picked by memCardScreenStep sub 1 refs=15

name: MEMCARD_PROBED
source: usage: int: set once the first probe of both slots ran (memCardScreenDraw shows the slot prompt before) refs=5

name: MEMCARD_PAD_LAST
source: usage: int: last d-pad state of memCardScreenUpdate's auto-repeat refs=3

name: MEMCARD_PAD_REPEAT_TIMER
source: usage: int: auto-repeat countdown of memCardScreenUpdate (0x20 then 4) refs=4

name: MEMCARD_CARDS
source: usage: Card[2]: per slot the 15 file names / status / block map memCardReadDirectory fills refs=6

name: MEMCARD_FILE_INFOS
source: usage: Info[2][15]: {short icon a b c; int d e; short p10 f} per directory entry from the save header (icon -1 none / -2 foreign file) refs=7

name: MEMCARD_SAVE_HEADER
source: usage: the 0x80 bytes at 0x200 of a save file memCardReadDirectory reads to fill MEMCARD_FILE_INFOS refs=8

name: MEMCARD_DIR_PATH
source: usage: char[0x20]: 'bu00:' + name path buffer of memCardReadDirectory refs=9

name: MEMCARD_FILE_PATH
source: usage: char[0x20]: 'bu00:' + file name path buffer of the erase / write / read in memCardFileListStep refs=11

name: MEMCARD_FILE_SUFFIX
source: usage: char[]: the 'TOMBA-NN' part of the file name memCardFileListStep keeps / sprintf's refs=4

name: MEMCARD_FILE_SUFFIX_FORMAT
source: usage: 'TOMBA-%02d' sprintf format of the save file suffix refs=2

name: MEMCARD_DIR_WILDCARD
source: usage: '*' appended to the port prefix for firstfile refs=2

name: MEMCARD_PORT_PREFIXES
source: usage: char *[2]: 'bu00:' / 'bu10:' of memCardReadDirectory refs=3

name: MEMCARD_PORT_PREFIXES_2
source: usage: char *[2]: the second 'bu00:' / 'bu10:' pair (memCardFileListStep / FormatStep) refs=6

name: MEMCARD_SAVE_PREFIXES
source: usage: char *[2]: 'BESCES-01330' / 'BESCES-01331' product prefixes by 1F8003D8 (memCardReadDirectory strstr) refs=2

name: MEMCARD_SAVE_PREFIXES_2
source: usage: char *[2]: the second 'BESCES-01330' / 'BESCES-01331' pair memCardFileListStep builds the save name from refs=2

name: MEMCARD_SLOT_SUFFIXES
source: usage: char *[15]: 'A-00'..'A-14' save slot suffixes matched against the file name refs=2

name: MEMCARD_FILE_ROW_POSITIONS
source: usage: {short x y}[] screen position of each file list row (memCardScreenDraw) refs=6

name: MEMCARD_MESSAGE_STRINGS
source: usage: string pointer table of the memory card messages (memCardDrawMessage n) refs=2

name: MEMCARD_MESSAGE_FRAMES
source: usage: {short x y w h}[n] balloon frame of each message refs=2

name: MEMCARD_YESNO_TILE_RECTS
source: usage: {short x y w h}[2] of the yes / no cursor tile by MEMCARD_YESNO_CURSOR (message 7) refs=5

name: MEMCARD_YESNO_TILE_RECTS_2
source: usage: the yes / no tile rects of message 12 refs=5

name: MEMCARD_YESNO_TILE_RECTS_3
source: usage: the yes / no tile rects of message 16 refs=5

name: MEMCARD_FOOTER_STRING
source: usage: the footer string memCardDrawMessage draws at (0x50 0xD4) refs=2

name: MEMCARD_EMPTY_SLOT_STRING
source: usage: the label string of an empty file slot (memCardDrawFileIcon) refs=2

name: MEMCARD_BACKGROUND_PARTS
source: usage: -1 terminated {x y u v w h cx cy} part list of the screen background refs=2

name: MEMCARD_SLOT_PROMPT_STRING
source: usage: the card slot prompt text (memCardDrawSlotSelect) refs=2

name: MEMCARD_SLOT1_LABEL_STRING
source: usage: the 'slot 1' label of memCardDrawSlotSelect refs=2

name: MEMCARD_SLOT2_LABEL_STRING
source: usage: the 'slot 2' label of memCardDrawSlotSelect refs=2

name: MEMCARD_FILE_ICON_PARTS
source: usage: part list of a save file's icon frame refs=2

name: MEMCARD_EMPTY_SLOT_PARTS
source: usage: part list of the empty slot frame refs=3

name: MEMCARD_FILE_CURSOR_PARTS
source: usage: part list of the selection highlight (memCardDrawFileCursor) refs=2

name: MEMCARD_SIGN_UVS
source: usage: {u8 u v}[2] of the two sign sprites before an 8-digit number (func_800EB948) refs=4

name: MEMCARD_DIGIT_SPRITES
source: usage: {u16 u v w h}[10] of the digit sprites memCardDrawNumber2 draws (800F6D36 / 38 / 3A are the v / w / h columns) refs=2

name: MEMCARD_SCROLL_ARROW_UVS
source: usage: {u8 u v}[2] of the up / down scroll arrows refs=2

name: MEMCARD_LOCATION_STRINGS
source: usage: int *[tbl]: per table the area / room name strings of a save's location (memCardDrawFileLocation) refs=2

name: MEMCARD_FILE_ICON_FRAME
source: usage: the sprite frame stored into MEMCARD_DRAW_PARAMS.frame for a file entry's icon refs=3
